generatedFrom: Re-based after the app-wide feedback work (toast tone/dismiss/pause, useActionFeedback across every mutation surface, PendingSubmitButton on 21 submit controls, DownloadAnchor on 12 download links, NavLink + useLinkStatus navigation progress). Total initial JS across the eight measured routes grew 2.0% gzip (+29310 bytes). The weight is client components where there were none: exports (+3.3%) and admin-tools (+3.8%) moved most because their download tiles were previously plain server-rendered anchors, and the toast and nav-link changes sit in the root layout so they touch every route. Checked for waste first: splitting the server-side download-token helpers out of the client bundle saved ~10 bytes, so Turbopack was already tree-shaking them. The remaining increase is the intended cost of the features, not accidental bloat. Ceilings retain the usual ~1.5% runner variance.
